title: Associativity component for the common-stage completed tensor lift
statement:
theorem completed_tensor_common_lift_constraints_associative
    (N : ∀ E, CompletedTensorFiniteModel l X R closed models E)
    (coherence : RingedDerivedTensorCoherence.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (ProEt.topology X) (ring l X R) closed models symmetry)
    (data : CompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit l X R closed models symmetry)
    (normalized : ∀ A B, data.tensor.hom.app (A, B) =
      (completedTensorCommonComponent l X R closed models N A B).hom) :
    ∀ A B C : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l (PadicAlgCl l) X,
      closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (data.tensor.hom.app (A, B)) (𝟙 _)) ≫
          data.tensor.hom.app ((commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) X).obj (A, B), C) ≫
          (ordinary l X R).map (pullbackTensorCommonAssociator l (PadicAlgCl l) X A B C).hom =
        (closed.monoidal.associator ((ordinary l X R).obj A) ((ordinary l X R).obj B)
          ((ordinary l X R).obj C)).hom ≫
          closed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) (data.tensor.hom.app (B, C))) ≫
          data.tensor.hom.app (A, (commonStageDerivedTensor l (PadicAlgCl l) X).obj (B, C))

proof.text: Use the explicit normalization hypothesis to replace data.tensor components by completedTensorCommonComponent. Represent all three objects and the two nested tensors at one finite coefficient field. Expand the normalized quotient-completion and scalar-counit squares; identify triple balanced pure sections and the native associator using coherence.associator_model. Identify the source coherent-reduction associator and its rational and common-stage representatives, then descend and cancel the common-field input and output isomorphisms. This entire associativity verification remains the named theorem obligation; no new split-off axiom is introduced.

proof_origin.place: Remark 6.8.15, the actual tensor functor, together with HRS Lemma 7.9 (literature/hemo-richarz-scholbach-constructible-sheaves_arXiv-2305.18131.pdf), the natural finite-field colimit equivalence; the explicit component construction already present in AdicCompletedTensorCommonLiftTensorUnit.

statement_change.what: The former data.tensor was arbitrary and unrelated to N; naturality and invertibility alone do not imply the associativity equation. Require equality to the explicit completedTensorCommonComponent family. In the only consumer, construct data together with this equality rather than assume it for an arbitrary tensorator. A degree-dependent sign twist on graded lines gives a concrete generic obstruction: the two (1,0,0) paths have scalar 1 and -1.
